This is a portfolio-level risk allocation overlay that reduces exposure during adverse equity-curve regimes without changing entry/exit signals.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry portfolio-level equity-curve adaptive sizing with different thresholds or scale factors. The system drawdowns are too shallow (6-11%) and trade count too low (18-22) for any static threshold/scale combo to produce meaningful improvement. Variance from sizing a handful of affected entries dominates any edge.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A fundamentally different portfolio-level risk mechanism (e.g. regime-based position count cap, not notional scaling) or a much higher-frequency trade universe where sizing changes affect hundreds of entries, not single digits.
post_run_reflection.realized_failure_mode: v_shaped_recovery_missed + too_few_trades_for_statistical_significance: drawdowns are shallow and brief so the 5% threshold rarely triggers, and when it does the scaled-down entries miss the recovery bounce. All 3 windows regressed uniformly, confirming this is a structural mismatch, not parameter sensitivity.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The system drawdowns peak at 6-11% and recover quickly (V-shaped). At 5% DD threshold, the adaptive sizing fires during the recovery phase and reduces notional on entries that historically capture the bounce-back. With only 18-22 trades per window, even a few affected entries materially drag PnL. The Sharpe improvement in late_strong (+0.20) reflects reduced variance from smaller positions, but the PnL cost ($5.8K) is not offset. The strategy edge comes from concentrated conviction entries; reducing them during drawdown fights the core design.

prediction.confidence_reason: The system max drawdown is 11.19% in mid_weak with 52% win rate suggesting clustered losses. Anti-Martingale sizing is theoretically sound (Kelly criterion implies sizing proportional to edge). No prior experiment has tested portfolio-level equity-curve-responsive sizing; nearest neighbor exp-20260524-002 was per-signal heat haircut, a different mechanism. Main risk: only 18-22 trades per window means sizing changes affect very few entries, and 5% DD threshold may trigger too late or not at all in the shallow-drawdown windows.
